statements.quote: By evaluating how the IRS can harness emerging AI capabilities to strengthen fraud detection, we can ensure that it can conduct efficient, thorough investigations and improve recovery of taxpayer dollars.
statements.context: His AI Tax Integrity Act of 2026 (H.R. 9501), a pilot program for the IRS to use AI to detect tax fraud, passed the House Ways and Means Committee.
statements.reason: Promotes AI as a tool against tax fraud and does not acknowledge catastrophic risk.

statements.source_label: Buchanan House press release (also quoted by Ripon Advance, 2026-03-06)
